host_bench.help.score: The server against its own history: «of usual» overall and by link, the ▲/▼ marks (SSH menu item 22)
host_bench.help.explain: In detail: the links — now, usually, of usual, the ▲/▼ marks
host_bench.help.bench: Check the server: CPU, memory, disk, channel and network (uses traffic — try --dry first)
host_bench.help.full: Full check: longer and more traffic
host_bench.help.yes: Do not ask: agree to the price and to installing sysbench and fio when they are missing
host_bench.price.title: The price of one server check:
host_bench.price.line: {mode}: ≈ {rx} MB download and {tx} MB upload, ≈ {cpu} min of CPU, up to {min} min
host_bench.price.caps: Traffic by the limits of the tests: on a fast channel a check may take this much
host_bench.price.measured: Traffic by the past scheduled checks
host_bench.price.geo_unknown: The country of the server is not known: unless the check finds it by the delays, the link is measured as for Russia (the upload to the allowed point or, in a full check, to the speed test servers of Russian providers), and the price has a margin
host_bench.price.pkgs: No {pkgs}: without them there are no CPU, memory and disk tests
host_bench.need_yes: A check uses traffic: without a terminal it starts only with --yes (the price — kaskadctl host bench --dry)
host_bench.started: The server check started ({mode}), number {id}. It takes up to {min} min
host_bench.wait_hint: Ctrl+C — stop waiting: the check goes on; see the result with kaskadctl host score
host_bench.wait_left: The check goes on without waiting. The result — kaskadctl host score
host_bench.wait_long: The check {id} has not finished yet. The result — kaskadctl host score
host_bench.done.partial: The check is done, some tests were not measured
host_bench.done.unknown: The result of the check {id} was not found. The result of all checks — kaskadctl host score
host_bench.score.none: Nothing to compare with yet: the server has never been checked
host_bench.score.none_hint: Check it: kaskadctl host bench (the price — with --dry)
host_bench.score.none_hint_screen: Check it — item 3 on this screen
host_bench.score.stale_bare: Not checked for a long time · latest check {date}
host_bench.score.first: First check, will settle within a day
host_bench.score.rel: Overall: {rel} of usual (100 — as usual for this server)
host_bench.score.rel_none: Nothing to compare with yet: {n} of {need} days of history
host_bench.score.rel_few: Overall nothing to compare with yet: links with history {n} of {need}
host_bench.score.retry: A sharp drop: I’ll check again at about {at}
host_bench.link.rel_none: nothing to compare with yet: {n} of {need} days of history
host_bench.read_fail: Could not read the results of the server checks: {error}
host_bench.help.confirm: The confirmation key of --dry --json: the check starts only at the same price and with the same programs to install
host_bench.confirm_need: Through MCP a check starts only with the confirmation key: get the price (host_score action=price), show it to the human and pass its confirm
host_bench.confirm_bad: The confirmation key does not fit: the price of the check, its kind or the programs to install have changed. Nothing started. Get the price again (kaskadctl host bench --dry --json, in MCP — host_score action=price), show it to the human and repeat with the new key
host_bench.panel.need_confirm: A check uses traffic and CPU time — look at its price and confirm. Nothing was started.
host_bench.panel.confirm_changed: The price of the check or the programs to install changed — look at the new price and confirm again. Nothing was started.
host_bench.panel.limit: Checks started from the panel today: {n} — the limit for a day. Nothing was started.
host_bench.panel.limit_full: Full checks started from the panel today: {n} — the limit for a day. A quick one can still be started.
host_bench.panel.need_install: The check needs programs to be installed — tick whether to install them. Nothing was started or installed.
host_bench.mcp.limit: Checks started via the AI assistant today: {n} — the limit for a day. Nothing was started.
host_bench.mcp.limit_full: Full checks started via the AI assistant today: {n} — the limit for a day. A quick one can still be started.
host_bench.installing: Installing {pkgs} (≈ {mb} MB). While it installs, Ctrl+C does nothing
host_bench.installing_bare: Installing {pkgs}. While it installs, Ctrl+C does nothing
host_bench.link.retry_confirmed: the repeated check confirmed the drop
host_bench.help.share: What the “Share” clip shows (built in the panel): raw figures, “overall”, 30 days; no addresses or names
host_bench.help.share_tariff: Add the machine: cores, memory, the port of the plan
host_bench.help.share_country: Add the country of the server
host_bench.help.share_cpu: Add the CPU model (when it holds no address or name)
host_bench.share.stale: Check the server first: there is no good check, or it is old.
host_bench.share.title: Share the check · {date}
host_bench.share.total: Overall: {n} of usual · 100 — as usual for this server
host_bench.share.total_none: Overall: nothing to compare with yet — links with history {n} of {need}
host_bench.share.days: 30 days: even — {ok} · warnings — {warn} · alarm or outage — {fail} · no data — {none}
host_bench.share.dropped.cpu: The CPU model won’t go into the clip: it looks like an address, a name or a key.
host_bench.share.dropped.country: The country won’t go into the clip: the code is not an ISO one.
host_bench.share.where: The clip and the picture are built by the browser: panel → Overview › Server check → Share.
host_bench.price.upload_ru: A full check also measures the upload — to the speed test servers of Russian providers (iperf3); it can be turned off before the start
host_bench.help.no_upload_ru: A full check without measuring the upload to the speed test servers of Russian providers (iperf3). By default a server in Russia measures it: the point sees the address of the server
